title: Change declaration - principal-replacement
description: governance/change-declarations/<declaration-key>.yml with kind: principal-replacement - governed intent that the external principal behind a group key is being replaced, never approval evidence (T06 #8 d5). No approved_by, approval timestamps, GroupIds, ARNs, or account IDs: runtime identifiers appear only in generated plan/apply evidence (GOV-DECLARATION). A GroupId change is expected and declared; no GroupId value ever appears here. Plan-gate matching is GOV-DECL-MATCH.

schema_version.description: Declaration schema version (T06 #8 d5); the current version is 1 and changes atomically with this schema (T14 #19 d8).

key.description: Stable declaration key; equals the filename stem exactly.

owner.description: A T06 #8 principal key (declared ownership, not approval).

change_reference.description: Immutable reference to the change this declaration authorizes (issue/PR URL or equivalent immutable identifier).

deployment_scope.description: The permitted deployment scope of the exceptional operation.

valid_until.description: Mandatory; indefinite declarations are prohibited and expired declarations fail closed (T06 #8 d5).

affected_paths.description: The governed paths this declaration covers.

expected_plan_effect_class.description: The expected plan-effect class the plan gate matches (GOV-DECL-MATCH).

lab_exception_reference.description: Applicable lab-exception reference, if any (T06 #8 d5).

group_key.description: The workforce-group key whose external principal is replaced; the key itself is unchanged.

reason.description: Why the external principal is replaced.

group_id_change_expected.description: Explicit statement that a GroupId change is expected; no GroupId value appears anywhere in this declaration.
